Discipline.title: Warnings
Discipline.intro: The charter's warnings (art. 27 and 28): who gives them, how, and what follows.

rules.authority: The project manager warns the members of their project; the Executive Bureau may warn anyone. The department head gives none: they report the breach.
rules.grounds: Grounds: work not done without valid reason, commitments not kept, no communication on progress, rules not respected. A blocker reported properly is never, by itself, a ground.
rules.first: 1st warning: official, with the rule concerned and what is expected.
rules.second: 2nd warning: a council gathers the Team Manager, the project manager, the department head and the member, who gives their version.
rules.third: 3rd warning: exclusion from the team, confirmed by the Bureau.
rules.immediate: Immediate exclusion (art. 28) for serious facts: violence, harassment, threats, sabotage, theft, endangering, damage, disclosure.

serious.image: Serious harm to the team or its image

Discipline.expectedLabel: What is expected to correct it
Discipline.reportIntro: The member's project manager (or the Bureau) is told and decides what follows. The member does not see the report.
Discipline.giveIntro: The member is told, by e-mail too, and may give their version.
Discipline.nextLevel: It will be warning no. {level} of the season.
Discipline.alreadyThree: This member already has three warnings this season: see the exclusion.
Discipline.thirdNotice: A third warning prepares the exclusion, which the Bureau confirms.
Discipline.councilIntro: A second warning calls a council: the ERP creates the session and invites the Team Manager, the project manager, the department head and the member.
Discipline.confirmExclusionWarning: Confirming deactivates {name}'s account and ends their memberships. Continue?
